description: This is an HTML file serving as a front-end interface for a database visualizer web application. It includes layout, styling, and embedded JavaScript for dynamically loading and displaying database, table, and data information.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and updates the sidebar with database items.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles the expanding/collapsing of database item to show or hide its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database from the backend API and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table from data records, incorporating expandable cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles the expansion of cell content to show full or truncated data.
